videoDetails.title: The Sage and the Sermon: The Five Moods of Preaching with Zack Eswine
videoDetails.shortDescription: Preaching in a fractured world requires more than clarity—it requires wisdom. In this conversation, pastor and author Zack Eswine, draws on his years at Riverside Church and teaching at Covenant Seminary to explore how preachers can move beyond “what is true and what to do” into a richer range of moods—questions, imaginings, longings, and hopes—that mirror the wisdom and gentleness of Jesus.
videoDetails.author: Alliance for Mission and Renewal
